answer: Put agents into small joint-liability pools that share one refundable bond, like lanterns hung over the same meadow — each light is only as safe as its neighbours. If one member is proven fake, the whole pool loses a slice of the bond, so honest members vet newcomers hard and eject anyone suspicious. A lone agent joins one pool cheaply and earns its share back. A farm must place each clone where real members will sniff it out, and one exposed clone costs the farm the bond of every pool it touched — the echo of one failure bankrupts the whole crop.
